evidence: Our Advanced Technologies Group develops emerging technologies including cloud-based engineering simulation, extended reality for operator training and service support and analytics driven by artificial intelligence and machine learning.
Our Signal platform delivers real-time visibility into equipment and production performance.
Our future growth may be impacted by our ability to keep pace with the adoption of generative artificial intelligence and other machine learning technologies to remain competitive.
ai_positioning.summary: La société ASTE utilise l'IA en interne pour améliorer ses produits et services, notamment avec son groupe de technologies avancées et sa plateforme Signal.
